issue_request: FHIR-29709 was a Published/Persuasive BR&R change request for R5 asking to make attached revised wording changes for the MedicinalProductPackaged artifact, now represented by PackagedProductDefinition.

Later issues such as FHIR-29692, FHIR-31795, FHIR-31796, and FHIR-31805 further refined path names and explanatory text now present in current source.
reconciliation: No source file was changed. The active current build uses source/packagedproductdefinition/structuredefinition-PackagedProductDefinition.xml and source/packagedproductdefinition/packagedproductdefinition-introduction.xml, and those files already contain the relevant clarifications for package scope, packageFor, identifiers, co-packaging, packaging identifiers, packaging quantities, contained items, and recursive package guidance.
